title: Week 43: Riigikogu
content:
Week 43: Riigikogu

This week is the mid-term. That means I have a week off. But a lot things happened this week.



I went to the Estonian Parliament to do a visit. It is a 246 year building. But inside of it is neoclassical decoration. there are 101 seats, elected every 4 years. During the visit, someone asked me, how many seats in the Chinese parliament. I think it is a simple question. But I don't know. So I checked only. The nearest institution that is similar to the parliament is the standing committee of China's Central congress. It has 175 seats with 5 years term.



Linus kicked a lot Russian accounts out of the Linux community. A big shock in open source community. Many people believe it will ruin the open source community. But I think it still need time to see the result.

I touched pixel watch for the first time. I really like the design. But I worry the pebble shell can not last long.

Mac mini is like twice price here than PinDuoDuo. I know I will have 2 years' warranty. But it is a lot of money. Apple is going to announce new Mac mini. I hope it is not what I want. So I can hang out more not to decide to find a job.

Extraordinary

I finished the second season of Extraordinary. Expecting the third season.

Bolt scooter

My first try on bolt scooter. Super scared of the speed.
